maria: noticing a p99 jump on hosted for model-x v2, ~6s right now, p95 ~1.2s. started ~09:07 UTC :eyes:

dan: can you dump the queue depth/route metrics? sounds like queuing/backpressure

maria: charts -> https://grafana.redwood/hosted/model-x/latency spike correlates w/ queue_depth per-instance rising from 4->28 in 2m

priya: any recent deploys to that fleet?

maria: no deploys from deploy-bot since 08:45, deploy-bot below:

deploy-bot: no active rollouts to model-x-fleet since 2024-04-12T08:45:12Z

kevin: I saw a noisy tenant using long context streaming hitting a lot of cold KV priming earlier. Could be KV cache churn + batch sampler starvation.

maria: logs show a lot of `kvcache_miss` spikes and many tiny requests that prevent coalescing. example snippet from instance-17:

```
2024-04-12T09:07:30Z instance-17 INFO request_id=abc kvcache_miss=true seq_len=64 batch_size=1 model=model-x kernel=vec_gemm
2024-04-12T09:07:30Z instance-17 WARN sampler_sleep_ms=0 queue_depth=24
```

priya: can you run a quick profile (cpu/gpu) and `pprof` heap? I want to rule out GC stalling.

maria: running `ssh infra@instance-17 -- sudo perf record -a -g -- sleep 30` now, grabbing heap via runtime-bot, will paste flame quickly

runtime-bot: pprof link -> https://profiler.redwood/pprof/1728501234/instance-17 (flamegraph generated)

kevin: flame shows time in `sampler::try_coalesce` and `kvcache::evict` loops. also notable syscalls around `epoll_wait` on small bursts.

priya: that points to tight loop: sampler trying to coalesce but gets starved by many single-request sessions (burst of tiny streams). kernel selection flips to slower `vec_gemm` due to short padding predictions -> worse latency.

maria: we can try immediate mitigation: reduce sampler coalesce wait from 5ms -> 2ms for the fleet, and bump kvcache capacity by +10% to reduce eviction churn. want to patch?

dan: +1 for short-term patch. do we have rollout plan? canary 5% -> 25% in 2m steps, monitor p99. add temporary rate limit for streaming tenant if spike persists.

kevin: also set kernel affinity override to prefer `fast_attn` variant for sequences <128 for these instances to avoid vec_gemm fallback. That should cut worst-case tails.

maria: patch created, pushing canary now:

```
kubectl -n hosted rollout restart deploy/sampler-fleet --record
# configmap change: sampler.coalesce_ms=2 kvcache.target_capacity_pct=110 kernel.affinity_override=fast_attn_short
```

runtime-bot: canary rollout started -> 5% at 09:11 UTC

priya: monitoring dashboards...

maria: p99 dropped to 1.9s in canary within 90s, queue_depth back to ~6.

dan: nice. promote to 25% and observe 5m then full if stable. also open follow-up ticket for long-term: adaptive coalesce by workload fingerprint + tenant-level burst protection.

kevin: opened RFC: https://go.redwood/rfc/adaptive-sampler-2024 (assign to infra-srv)

maria: creating incident postmortem note, tagging oncall + runtime-owners. thanks all :thumbsup:

maria: incident resolved to mitigated status at 09:22 UTC, will keep watch for 2 hours.
